attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial operations at New Client Support Centre Facility at Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has commenced operations at its new Client Support Centre Facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, effective November 18, 2026. This follows an earlier intimation dated July 25, 2026. The facility is located at A-33, Sector-136, Noida, and covers an area of approximately 17,700 sq. ft. The company states this expansion reinforces its commitment to strengthening healthcare infrastructure and expanding access to Ayurvedic healthcare services. The disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The information will be uploaded on the company website at www.jeenasikho.com.

attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission of audio recording of Earnings Conference Call   Q2 FY 2026-27
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited submitted the audio recording of its Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY 2026-27 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on 16 November 2026. The call was held on Monday, November 16, 2026, to discuss Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://jeenasikho.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Earning-Call-Recording-16-11-2026.mp3. The submission was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was signed by Manish Grover, Managing Director, with DIN 07557886, from Zirakpur, Punjab.

attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Submission of Newspaper Publication Clipping of Extract of the Unaudited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year Ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited submitted newspaper publication clippings of the extract of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 14, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express and Nawanzamana on November 16, 2026. The information is available on the company website at www.jeenasikho.com. The letter was signed by Manish Grover, Managing Director, with DIN 07557886.

attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited submitted an investor presentation to the NSE and BSE on November 15, 2026, pursuant to SEBI regulations. The presentation supports the earnings conference call scheduled for November 16, 2026, discussing financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The document is also available on the company website at www.jeenasikho.com. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations grew 26% year-on-year to Rs. 460 crore. Profit after taxes stood at Rs. 102 crore. Gross margin remained at 88%. The company reported 2,424 operational beds across 62 hospitals and 60 clinics.

attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Outcome of the Meeting of the Board of Directors of Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited held on November 14, 2026 for the declaration of Unaudited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. The results include Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors Walker Chandiok & Co LLP. The auditors confirmed that the financial statements comply with Indian Accounting Standard 34 and SEBI Listing Regulations. The review found no material misstatements. The standalone total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 62,669.08 lacs. Revenue from operations for the six months ended September 30, 2026, was 45,953.39 lacs. The company has two subsidiaries, Jeena Sikho International LLC and Jeena Green Resources Private Limited. The Managing Director Manish Grover signed the intimation.

attchmntText: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation of Schedule of Analyst / Investor Meet/ Conference under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited, symbol JSLL, has intimated the schedule for an investor meet under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company's management will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference hosted by Avendus Spark Institutional Equities. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, 18th November, 2026. It will be a physical meeting held at Grand Hyatt, Kalina, Mumbai. The timing is from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. The interaction type is listed as 1x1, Group, or In-Person. The schedule is indicative and subject to change. The company states it will refer only to publicly available documents. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed. The information is also available on the company website at https://jeenasikho.com/. The intimation was signed by Manish Grover, Managing Director, with DIN 07557886.
